title: Jump Game
statement_short: Given an integer array nums where each element represents your maximum jump length from that position, determine if you can reach the last index starting from index 0.
hint: Array length up to 10^4 requires an O(n) solution by continually expanding the furthest reachable index.
why_not: Right: Greedy maintains the maximum reachable index while scanning left-to-right in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Graph BFS: Level-by-level queue traversal visits reachable nodes but uses O(n) auxiliary memory. Not Backtracking: Trying every jump branch recursively causes TLE with O(2^n) exponential complexity. Not 2D DP: A two-dimensional state space is unnecessary for tracking a single reachability boundary.
